title: Techstack own application v3

hostname.description: Exactly own-<name>.<installation-domain>; checked contextually by StackKits. It routes the one service that declares httpPort.

services.description: The containers of the project. Exactly one service declares httpPort and is routed; every other service stays on the project's private network. The same refusals as for one container apply to every service: no host ports, no privileged mode, no host mounts, and images pinned by digest at review.

name.description: Compose service name; also the container name on the project's private network.

image.description: Public DNS registry over HTTPS port 443 only. Create/update dry review resolves every tag before approval; offline render requires digest-pinned desired images. Execution binds the reviewed resolvedImages, imports the verified blobs through the same HTTPS transport, and runs the node-derived immutable config image ID with pull_policy never.

httpPort.description: The container port that serves HTTP. Exactly one service of the project declares it; that service is the routed one.

secretRefs.description: Each key K must reference exactly secret://own-<name>/<service>/K; created via the own operation private secrets-file under the <service>.<KEY> slot, never foreign custody.

mountPath.description: Clean absolute container path; system paths, host mounts and Docker socket are refused. The named volume of this service is included in backup.

dependsOn.description: Services of this project that start first. Unknown services, self references and cycles are refused.

description: Closed v3 own-application intent: a Compose project of one to eight containers. Exactly one service declares httpPort and is routed on the project hostname; the other services stay on the project's private network. Their declared named volumes are included in backup. A project has no outbound Internet: the v2 outboundInternet grant belongs to the one-container form only.
